in_marathi.name: Sahasran
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sahasran हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Represents the ultimate power and strength. A name for a boy born into a powerful and prosperous family.
